# Cadence

> Cadence is a creator marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands. It puts a brand's product in the hands of 100–500 vetted TikTok and Instagram Reels creators at once, all posting within the same 6 weeks, with every post tracked.

## What Cadence does
- Selects and vets creators one by one (real audience, right niche, brand-safe content).
- Handles outreach, briefs and follow-up; the brand ships one product package per creator.
- Tracks every video and view on a live client dashboard.
- Campaign: 2 weeks of setup, then 6 weeks of publishing. Guarantee: at least 80% of the creators the brand approves publish in the window, or the gap is replaced or refunded. Every post and view is tracked; no view count is promised.
- After the 6 weeks: optional ambassador program with the best-performing creators.

## Why it matters
- Paid social keeps getting more expensive (Meta average price per ad +10% in 2024, +9% in 2025).
- Attention is fragmented across TikTok, Reels, Shorts and thousands of niches; people follow people.
- U.S. creator ad spend reached $37B in 2025, +26% (IAB).
- Creators fill the top of the funnel; brands' retargeting ads then convert a warmer audience.

## Who it is for
DTC brands (sport, fitness and consumer goods first), mainly in the US and internationally.
